proposed.statement: Fix \( (P,B^0,\varepsilon,\Gamma,\pi_0)\in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\) and let \(\mathcal O_G\) be its observed moments for an arbitrary view graph \(G\). A permutation \(\pi\) is a source-to-sink path in \(\mathcal D_G\) if and only if \(\pi\in\Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\). For every such path, each \(Q_{\pi,j}\) has a positive-definite completion obtained as a coordinate principal block of a full residual covariance, and independently assembling these completed blocks yields a component-aligned Gaussian completion with coefficient tuple \(T_\pi\).

proposed.statement: Fix \( (P,B^0,\varepsilon,\pi_0)\in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\), and let \(\mathcal O_G\) be its observed moments for an arbitrary view graph \(G\). Then \(\operatorname{Enum}_G(\mathcal O_G)\) emits exactly \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)=\{T_\pi:\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\}\), each numerical tuple once. As non-novel post-processing of that exact-once tuple stream, it also computes \(\mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G)\). In the ordered exact-real model \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{ER}}\), full-lattice construction and pruning, exact lexicographic row interning, integer-fragment trie propagation, decoding, output, and common-ancestry intersection require \(O(\operatorname{poly}(p,m)2^p\max\{1,N_{\mathrm{out}}\})\) total time and space. An explicit time bound is \[O\!\left(mp^3 2^p+p^3 2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}+mp^2N_{\mathrm{out}}\right).\] No hash oracle on real numbers, no cross-view residual zero test, and no traversal of all \(p!\) orders is used.

proposed.statement: Under the premises of \(\texttt{thm:exact-once-output-sensitive-enumeration}\), suppose every entry of the rational input \(\mathcal O_G\) has binary encoding length at most \(L_{\mathrm{bits}}\). The fraction-free immutable-row implementation of \(\operatorname{Enum}_G\), including common-ancestry computation, has deterministic total bit-operation time and bit storage polynomial in \(p\), \(m\), \(L_{\mathrm{bits}}\), \(2^p\), \(N_{\mathrm{out}}\), and the total emitted encoding length. Canonically reduced determinant-ratio certificates decide equality of interned rows. Thus no superpolynomial intermediate or certificate growth is forced in this rational published-class regime.

proposed.statement: On an input generated by \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\), the relation \(\mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G)\) is exactly the set of ordered pairs \((i,j)\) for which \(i\) is an ancestor of \(j\) in the union-support DAG of every tuple in \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)\). Given the exact-once tuple stream, it is computable by exact zero tests, transitive closure, and intersection in \(O(N_{\mathrm{out}}(mp^2+p^3))\) additional time and \(O(p^2)\) working space beyond the tuple being processed.

prose_updates.tldr: The observed covariance law supports two exact but different conclusions. Under the published shared-order LiMVAM primitives, unrestricted cross-view disturbance dependence makes every order covariance-compatible and makes common union-support ancestry empty, so pairing contributes neither pruning nor ancestry. Under the component-aligned subclass, the independently defined mechanism fiber is exactly represented by source-to-sink paths of the live \(q\)-DAG. A two-mode immutable-row dynamic program emits each distinct coefficient tuple once; its pairing-informative component-aligned mode runs in \(O((m+|E|)p^3 2^p+p^3 2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}^{\mathrm{CA}}+mp^2N_{\mathrm{out}}^{\mathrm{CA}})\) ordered exact-real time and computes the nontrivial subclass ancestry intersection, with a corresponding rational output-polynomial guarantee.

project_justification.gap: The parent calibration frontier had a \(2^p\)-state compatibility recursion but no noncircular exact-once enumeration of distinct numerical coefficient tuples. The previous repair correctly exposed the unrestricted-cross-view all-orders boundary but left the pairing-informative component-aligned coefficient target as an observable order refinement rather than an independent mechanism projection.
project_justification.niche: The note separates the published mechanism fiber from its component-aligned subclass fiber. Within-view normal equations uniquely map any fiber mechanism and order to its immutable modified-Cholesky rows. The published fiber projects onto all orders, whereas the component-aligned fiber projects exactly onto live \(q\)-DAG paths by residual factorization and positive-definite coordinate completion.
project_justification.fill: Source-to-sink pruning makes every retained prefix extendable. Equal immutable original-label fragments at a fixed removed set have identical suffix outputs, unequal fragments have disjoint completion sets, and each bucket charges to at most the final numerical output count. Exact row sorting and integer tries therefore yield exact-once full-lattice and q-pruned enumerators without a real hash oracle or factorial order traversal.

sampling_model.design: The population input is the exact collection of within-view covariance blocks and cross-view blocks observed on an arbitrary fixed graph \(G\). The published mode uses only marginal regressions because edge residuals are unrestricted nuisance. The component-aligned mode additionally computes edgewise Schur states and \(q\)-scores, constructs the full \(2^p\) compatibility DAG, and prunes it from source to sink.
sampling_model.units: Within each covariance source, observations are independent and identically distributed from the corresponding marginal of one target law \(P\). Different sources need not be independent because units may be reused.
sampling_model.treatment: There is no designated treatment. The structural targets are the coefficient projections of the published and component-aligned mechanism fibers and the ancestry relations common to their union-support DAGs.
sampling_model.overlap: Only edges of \(G\) require paired measurements. The published layer assumes centered finite-second-moment product disturbances within each view, positive within-view variances, and a shared order, while allowing arbitrary cross-view disturbance covariance. The pairing-informative layer additionally assumes cross-coordinate component alignment and positive-definite coordinate-stack covariance.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: All new results are exact population identification and enumeration statements. Sampling uncertainty is inherited only through the parent's covariance-region inversion; no new estimator rate, limit law, polynomial enumeration of a continuum region, or substitution of a point enumerator for region inversion is claimed.

prose_updates.related_work: HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM supplies the shared-order multi-view structural model and recursive residual perspective. The present all-orders theorem records the covariance boundary under its primitive unrestricted cross-view layer, while component-aligned \(q\)-screening is an explicitly stronger maintained subclass. GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects motivates quotienting structural representatives by causal output, while WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration enumerates graph-distinct orientations and WangEtAl2023EquivalenceClasses studies local-color quotients in decomposable acyclic AND--OR graphs. DeepHuKoutris2021ProjectedEnumeration demonstrates the general importance of output charging after projection, and AvisFukuda1996ReverseSearch gives generic exact-enumeration context. ConteEtAl2025OutputSensitiveSurvey is relevant as broad output-sensitive-enumeration context, but it does not supply the immutable-row quotient theorem. BoegeEtAl2026ColoredGaussianDAG is adjacent Gaussian-DAG algebra, not a source for the transformed-covariance witness or the enumeration result. ShimizuEtAl2011DirectLiNGAM supplies recursive-residual LiNGAM ancestry, whereas the multi-view full-lattice and component-aligned completion arguments are proved here. TaylorEtAl2017CamCAN motivates the intended MEG and MRI application setting and contributes no mathematical premise. GroneEtAl1984PositiveDefiniteCompletion marks the adjacent chordal completion boundary; maintained component-aligned inputs here obtain completions from a full residual covariance rather than an off-model completion oracle. Bareiss1968SylvesterIdentity supplies the cited fraction-free elimination fact. None of these sources is claimed to provide the exact-once numerical tuple enumerator, live-fragment congruence, or projection bound.
prose_updates.interpretation: Unrestricted cross-view pairing is causally uninformative at the covariance level in this model: every order has a Gaussian covariance witness, and choosing the reverse order for any pair proves that published common ancestry is empty. Component alignment changes the conclusion. Its observed edge blocks prune the order set through the live \(q\)-DAG, and the exact-once stream yields a potentially nonempty common ancestry intersection. Numerical fragment merging can be substantial in both modes because many structural orders may induce the same coefficient tuple.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The guarantees are total output-sensitive bounds over an explicit \(2^p\) state space, not polynomial delay and not polynomial time in \(p\). Ordered exact-real arithmetic is not a floating-point stability guarantee; the rational theorem controls bit complexity only. The \(q\)-DAG theorem requires maintained component-aligned inputs and does not provide polynomial preprocessing for arbitrary off-model nonchordal partial covariances. Gaussianity is used only to construct existential completion witnesses, not assumed of the generating law. The results enumerate exact population coefficient sets, not continuum-valued covariance-region inverses.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The published shared-order class retains arbitrary cross-view disturbance covariance: pairing supplies neither order pruning nor common ancestry there, although the full-lattice algorithm still removes numerical duplicates without enumerating permutations. The pairing-informative result is exactly the component-aligned subclass with positive-definite coordinate covariance blocks, on an arbitrary observed view graph and at model-generated population moments. It proves q-path/fiber equivalence, exact-once tuple enumeration, nontrivial ancestry post-processing, ordered-exact-real complexity, and rational output-polynomial complexity. It does not claim unrestricted LiMVAM identification, polynomial delay, off-model nonchordal completion, floating-point robustness, or finite enumeration of the parent's covariance-region inverse.
